text: A thesaurus walked into a bakery and asked the baker for a loaf of sourdough. The baker looked at him and said, "I don't have any sourdough, but I do have a synonym for it: 'tangy bread.'" The dinosaur sighed and replied, "That's not what I meant. I was looking for the main ingredients in bread, not a thesaurus entry." The baker shrugged and said, "Well, the main ingredients are flour, water, yeast, and salt. But if you want to get technical, you could also call it 'edible dough' or 'carbohydrate brick.'" The dinosaur nodded and said, "Thanks. I'll take two of those 'carbohydrate bricks,' please."
